headline: Mechanix co-founder guitarist Syed Imran Ahmed dies after cancer battle
summary: Syed Imran Ahmed, a co-founder and guitarist of the popular Bangladeshi rock band Mechanix, has passed away after a prolonged fight with cancer. His death was announced by the band's frontman.
details: Syed Imran Ahmed, a co-founder and guitarist of the renowned Bangladeshi rock band Mechanix, has died after a year and a half battle with cancer. The news was confirmed by Aftabuzzaman Tridib, the frontman of Mechanix, who shared the information on social media.

In a heartfelt post, Tridib described Ahmed as a brother and urged friends and fans to keep him in their prayers. "Syed Imran Ahmed, ex-guitarist and co-founder of Mechanix, has left us for eternity. He was struggling with cancer for the last one and a half years. I lost one of my brothers. Keep him in your prayers," Tridib wrote.

Ahmed was a significant figure in the country's rock music scene, known for his contributions as a guitarist. His role as a co-founder of Mechanix marked him as a key figure in the band's history and its impact on Bangladeshi music.
caption:

headline: Early morning rain causes waterlogging in Dhaka, sparking commuter woes
summary: Heavy rainfall in the capital city has left roads flooded, disrupting travel for thousands of residents during the morning rush hour.
details: Early morning rainfall in Dhaka has led to significant waterlogging across various parts of the city.
The sudden accumulation of water on the roads has caused severe disruptions for commuters traveling to work and offices.
Rickshaws and other vehicles are seen navigating through flooded streets, slowing down the overall pace of traffic.
Residents have expressed frustration over the recurring issue of waterlogging following even moderate rainfall in the capital.
caption:
